Where can I find your full shipping policy?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
You can view our full shipping policy on our website’s SHIPPING POLICY page, typically linked in the footer at checkout or at the bottom of the site. If you’d like, I can also help answer a specific shipping question here—like delivery times, international shipping, or address changes.
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Yes — we offer international shipping to most countries via APC Postal Logistics. Shipping costs vary by country and are calculated at checkout, and delivery typically takes around 25 business days due to customs processing. For customs fees or import duties, those can vary by destination; if you need the exact charges for your country, a team member can help confirm.
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Standard Shipping typically takes 4–7 BUSINESS DAYS FOR FULFILLMENT once the order is placed. If you need help with a specific order, I can help point you in the right direction.
What's your return and refund policy?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Our return window is 14 DAYS AFTER YOU RECEIVE THE ITEM. To be eligible, the item must be in ORIGINAL CONDITION, UNWORN OR UNUSED, WITH TAGS ATTACHED, IN THE ORIGINAL PACKAGING, AND WITH A RECEIPT OR PROOF OF PURCHASE.
A $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from each refund. INTERNATIONAL ORDERS EXCEPT CANADA, INTIMATES, BODYSUITS, JEWELRY, ALL MARKDOWN/SALE ITEMS, AND GIFT CARDS ARE NON-RETURNABLE. Items returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS are STORE CREDIT ONLY, and the same applies to FINAL-SALE ITEMS.
To start a return, use our return portal: https://nakedwardrobe.com/apps/aftership-returns…
